Method of Attack: Collect and send SMS text messages to a remote server every 72 hours
Collect and send call log information every 72 hours
Collect and send user personally identifiable information every 24 hours
Collect and send the phone's IMSI and IMEI identifiers
Collect and send a list of installed applications
Download and install applications without user consent
Update phone firmware and reprogram the device
Execute remote commands with elevated privileges
Impacted Systems: Android smartphones including BLU R1 HD and many low-end budget Android models
Indicators of Compromise: Communication with a server belonging to Shanghai Adups Technology Co. Ltd. in China
